thread:
sasha: Hey team — seeing a spike of 502s from embeddings /eu-west1 since 00:12. Root cause looks like a scoring fallback that reverted to an old quantized model. Need an expedited hotpatch deploy within the next 30m. Asking for approval to skip normal staged canary and do a quick-cutover (recover path ready).

deploybot: Auto-check: CI: ✅ (unit/integration), E2E: running (8/10 passed), infra-checks: ✅, dependent-migrations: none. To deploy use: ```sh ./deploy.sh --service=embeddings --region=eu-west1 --image=ghcr.io/redwood/embeddings@sha256:ab12cd34 --emergency-window```

liam: How bad is user impact? numbers?

ops-oncall: ~18% error rate on POST /embed in eu-west1 last 10m, upstream retries causing latency spikes ~700ms -> increases cost and degrades product features in region. Not system-wide but affects multiple orgs.

maria: Any DB or schema changes in that image?

sasha: No DB touches, purely runtime model binary swap and config tweak to use stable KV cache policy. Short changelog: "revert model->stable-quant-v2, tighten kv-cache ttl". Commit: ab12cd34.

deploybot: Canary policy requires 15m gradual rollout. Emergency path allows operator approval + ops-lead signoff to skip canary. Please ack with explicit approval phrase: "approve emergency deploy".

dylan: approve emergency deploy :thumbsup: — I'm oncall and will watch metrics.

security: Quick check — does this image include new third-party libs or changed endpoints?

sasha: No new deps. Same container base + model artifact swap. No external calls introduced.

ops-lead: I grant emergency deploy for eu-west1 only. Condition: if error rate doesn't drop below 2% within 10m, auto-rollback. Also keep fallback routing to eu-central enabled. Document the release note in #release-notes after deploy.

maria: Leaving a guard: ensure deployterrors escalate to oncall via alerts and we have rollback cmd ready: ```sh kubectl rollout undo deploy/embeddings -n prod --to-revision=stable-2026-03-03```

deploybot: E2E completed: 10/10 passed. Preflight passed. Ready to execute on confirmation.

ops-oncall: I'll start dashboards and set alert thresholds. Will monitor tokenized request queue and cost metrics.

liam: +1 from product; customer-facing impact significant. Go for it.

sasha: Initiating deploy now. Pushing image and triggering emergency rollout.

deploybot: Starting emergency rollout to eu-west1: batch-size=100% (override), timeout=10m. Logs: "pulling sha256:ab12cd34 -> starting replicas"

ops-oncall: First minute: error rate dropping to 7%. Latency down to 320ms.

deploybot: 5m checkpoint: health-checks OK, 95% readiness across pods.

dylan: Monitoring trace samples — embeddings quality looks stable.

security: Noted, no anomalies in network egress.

ops-lead: Good. Keep fallback in place and do postmortem with prevention action: add model rollout gating to CI.

sasha: Marking release notes draft: "hotfix: embeddings eu-west1 — model rollback to stable-quant-v2 to mitigate 502s; retained KV cache settings." Will post to #release-notes after finish.

deploybot: Deploy complete. Final health: error rate 1.9% in eu-west1, latency 210ms. Closed emergency window.

maria: Filing quick incident ticket with timeline.

liam: Thanks all — nice quick coordination.

ops-oncall: Keeping watch for 1h and will escalate if any regression.

sasha: Closing thread. :heavy_check_mark:
